design.bootstrap: 2,000 paired outer held-county baseline/model SSE block resamples, counties sampled with replacement within each official region.
design.feature: fraction of provided Overture building centroids assigned strictly within an ACS tract whose nearest provided Overture road is farther than radius
design.inner_selection: For every outer held county within region, choose the radius with minimum pooled inner leave-one-county-out squared error among remaining outer-training counties; equivalently maximize pooled inner delta-R2 against zero correction. Exact ties choose smaller radius.
design.metric: Pooled and regional outer OOF delta-R2=(zero-correction S1 residual SSE - selected-radius OOF residual SSE)/zero-correction SSE.
design.outcome_interpretation: Frozen S1 cross-fitted estimator-disagreement residual only; not labels, target score, accuracy, or promotion evidence.
design.outer_validation: Within each official region, hold out each supported five-digit county FIPS once; fit intercept plus standardized linear T5 term on all other supported counties using training-only feature mean/population SD.
design.radius_selection_leakage_control: Each outer held county is excluded from both inner radius selection and outer model fitting; outer outcome is used only once for evaluation.
design.undefined_support: Radius feature is undefined only when no provided building centroid is assigned to the tract; all candidate radii share this support.
